name: moniwork
description: Self-hosted HTTP monitoring on Cloudflare Workers. Paste a curl, get alerts in Google Chat, Telegram, Slack or Discord.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply moniwork --local && wrangler dev --local --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: (wrangler d1 migrations apply moniwork --remote || true) && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply moniwork --remote
scripts.seed: node scripts/seed.mjs > .wrangler/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute moniwork --local --file .wrangler/seed.sql

DB.description: Monitors, check history, incidents and notification channels.

AI.description: Writes a one-line explanation when a monitor goes down. Runs once per incident.

PROBER.description: Runs checks from US, EU and Asia for monitors that opt in.
